items.item: Requests come in via AppFolio portal, email to leasing office, and texts to Carlos
Carlos triages emergency vs routine
Assigns to in-house technician or outside vendor from Excel list
Owner approval needed for repairs over $500
Work order closed in AppFolio with invoice attached
About 340 units across six buildings
About 90 work orders a month, 15 emergencies
About 30 status calls a week
About nine days to close a work order
Two or three unmatched vendor invoices a month

QuickBooks
Requests via texts to a personal phone get lost / scattered

Single point of failure when Carlos is away (vacation week)

items_without_quote: Unmatched invoices frequency: 2–3 times per month.
Vendors do not show up or arrive late; no record kept in system. | Residents call upset; no one knows what happened because info was only in Carlos's texts.
After-hours emergency requests often lack proper documentation. | Invoices cannot be matched to units; bookkeeper must email Carlos to dig through texts.
**Required involvement:** Carlos (Maintenance Coordinator) must be present to know where issues are occurring.
